title: An ingest rewrites AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md without updating file_index in the same step
body: dc, 2026-09-12, found while widening the watcher: the index lags its own writer for the root files. On the leaf path it is masked by byte-identity (the rewrite is byte-identical and the write set skips it), and the two-registration ruling means no reconcile meets it, so it was a finding for the 3.0.2 cut and not a fix. The fix is the writer indexing what it writes before it releases. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.
